It computes work entries from contract schedules via periodic cron (ir_cron_data.xml) and on-demand wizard. Result (hr.work.entry records) flows to payroll (hr_payroll) for compensation computation.

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Computation Engine**: While root-level files are minimal, the `models/` subpackage contains the contract-to-work-entry computation logic (hours, overtime, leave accounting). The `wizard/` subpackage allows users to manually trigger recalculation.
- **Payroll Dependency**: Work entries generated here are the canonical input to payroll period computation. Changes to contracts trigger work entry regeneration via cron.
- **Belongs With**: hr_work_entry (foundation), hr_contract (source data), hr_payroll (consumer), hr_employee (extends), resource.calendar (availability calculation).
- **Periodic Task**: Uses ir_cron to auto-regenerate work entries on a schedule (e.g., daily or weekly). User can also manually trigger via regeneration_wizard.
- **Bridge Pattern**: This addon bridges the contract domain (hr_contract) and the work-entry domain (hr_work_entry), computing the relationship between the two.
